description: Zhihu Q&A homepage: SSR shell with js-initialData, classic-script boot + webpack chunk loader (createElement+appendChild script injection), feature-detection heavy. Platform work surfaced by this site: element interfaces, insertAdjacent*, NodeList, document.location, screen, fetch primitives (Headers/Request/Response), abort-aware guest fetch (real Promise + AbortSignal rejection), DCL/load lifecycle, and dynamic script execution. All 24 classic scripts evaluate with error null, injected chunks (sentry, zswsdid) are fetched+evaluated, and the app's DOMContentLoaded hydration runs (~190 mutations) — after which the app itself decides the guest session is unauthenticated and swaps in its error UI (title becomes 出了一点问题 - 知乎). That decision belongs to the page, not the engine; full interactivity needs the fresh-visitor cookie flow and is the next rung.

checks.description: all classic scripts evaluate with no uncaught boot error
guest scripts make real API/config fetches
the app renders a document whose title is zhihu's (SSR title, or the app's own error UI title)
the app's DOMContentLoaded hydration materially mutates the DOM
